text:
luis_support: FYI customer `acme` opened ticket — intermittent 502s from edge for hosted /v1/embeddings. Spike started ~2025-10-12T16:07:00Z. Seen on eu1 and us-west, mostly on large batch calls.

anna_prodeng: Can you paste a sample request id + curl? Any obvious pattern (large headers, long bodies)?

luis_support: sample req id: r-0a1b2c3d. Quick curl (sanitized):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\
  -H "X-Tenant-Id: acme" \\
  -H "X-Billing-Meta: a=1;b=2;...;z=26" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"small-embed","input":["...lots of texts..."]}'
```
Returns HTTP/1.1 502 sometimes, otherwise 200. Error rate goes up with batch size > 40.

mike_sre: Looking at edge traces for r-0a1b2c3d — upstream returned a reset mid-handshake. Envoy logs show repeated: `upstream reset: connection error: PROTOCOL_ERROR\n  details: header size exceeded` (snippet attached).

deploy-bot: deploy: `envoy-proxy` change "inject-billing-meta-v2" rolled at 2025-10-12T16:05:12Z by infra-pipeline.

luis_support: oh — billing team recently started injecting per-request billing headers (per-item metadatas) for cost attribution. That matches timeline.

anna_prodeng: hypothesis: header growth for large batch embeddings causes HTTP/2 header frames to exceed downstream/upstream limits, triggering resets and 502s. Can we repro locally?

mike_sre: Repro steps I used: curl above but added 100 `X-Billing-Item` headers (simulate many items). Observed 502 within 1-3 tries. Minimal repro: set batch size 60 + 30 billing headers.

luis_support: Customer sent a trace: `edge->auth->billing-injector->upstream`. When billing-injector added 20+ small headers, we see envoy close upstream.

infra-bot: Current envoy config: `max_request_headers_kb: 60` on the upstream cluster. Billing headers push some requests >70kb.

mike_sre: Immediate mitigation options:
- rollback billing injector (fast)
- increase `max_request_headers_kb` on envoy (config + rollout, riskier)
- collapse billing items into single JSON header so fewer headers sent (billing team change)

anna_prodeng: Which is fastest to ship right now?

luis_support: Billing team prefers server-side change (collapse), but that takes dev time. Quick action: rolled back injector on eu1 and us-west at 16:12.

deploy-bot: rollback: `inject-billing-meta-v2` -> SUCCESS at 2025-10-12T16:12:09Z.

mike_sre: After rollback observed 503/502 rate drop from 4.2% -> 0.2% over 10 minutes on impacted nodes. Looks promising.

luis_support: Customer confirmed degraded behaviour cleared after rollback. They still want root-cause and a fix that doesn't lose telemetry.

anna_prodeng: Action items:
- Billing: switch to single `X-Billing-Meta-JSON` header (owner: @billing-team, ETA 2 weeks)
- Infra: add header-size regression alert and consider bumping `max_request_headers_kb` on gateway clusters (owner: @infra, ETA 3d)
- SRE: run synthetic test for large-batch embeddings with billing headers (owner: @mike_sre, ETA 24h)

oncall-mary: Added incident tag and linked customer ticket. Will keep monitoring and update SLA notes.

luis_support: I'll send steps + curl snippet and the short repro to acme support ticket, plus note the temporary rollback.

mike_sre: Postmortem notes: avoid injecting per-item headers at edge; prefer condensed header or attach telemetry to body. Also add unit test that fails CI when header size growth > 50kb for embedding routes.

anna_prodeng: Thanks team. I'll coordinate follow-ups in the weekly infra sync. :thumbsup:
